messages:
maya: Heads-up: found an inconsistency in API reference examples for POST /v1/generate. cURL and the sample JSON payloads use "temp" but all SDKs use "temperature". Getting a few 400 reports from support.

samir: saw that ticket. which page exactly?

maya: docs/reference/generate.md — PR #4823 touched it.

julie: I can open a quick docs PR. Do we standardize on "temperature" in all examples?

alejandro: yes, canonical field name is "temperature". "temp" is only an alias at runtime. Docs should show canonical names.

julie: ok will update curl, python, js samples and the sample response (it currently shows an echoed "temp" field which is misleading).

julie: (curl) ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","temperature":0.6,"max_tokens":150,"prompt":"Explain CI in one sentence"}'
```

julie: (python) ```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-alpha-1", prompt="Explain CI in one sentence", temperature=0.6, max_tokens=150)
print(resp.text)
```

maya: looks good. add a short note under examples: "Note: the runtime accepts `temp` as an alias for backwards compatibility, but examples use the canonical field `temperature`."

julie: added that and fixed the sample response to remove the echoed "temp" key.

docs-bot: PR julie/docs-4823 updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 \u2014 standardized examples to "temperature"; clarified alias behavior; sample response fixed. CI: docs build passed. :white_check_mark:

samir: can we run a grep across /docs for occurrences of ""temp"":? I can spin up a quick grep job and open follow-ups if any hits.

alejandro: I can assign that to the contractor. thanks for the quick fix team :tada:

maya: closing this thread once PR merges. good catch everyone! :sparkles:
